text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up: today's GPU forecast run shows a ~30% dip for 'private' clusters — looks like ingestion dropped for zone-tagged usage. Query and sample logs below. Anyone from ingest side?

AJ Patel: On it. Which table are we querying? usage_events_aggregated?

Maria Chen: yes. query we ran:

```sql
SELECT region, zone, sum(gpu_seconds)/3600.0 as gpu_hours
FROM usage_events_aggregated
WHERE source='private' AND ts >= current_date - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY region, zone;
```

returns null zone for ~120k rows (mostly eu-west and ap-southeast).

Lee Nguyen: We shipped a client relayer change last week — v2 agent renamed `topology.zone` -> `zone_name`. Ingest mapper still expects `zone`. Looks like the value ended up in raw_events.topology.zone_name.

Sophia Ramos: If that's the case we should patch the parser to canonicalize both keys (`zone` or `zone_name`) into `zone`. I can open a PR. Backfill required but watch schema variations for private installs.

Zach O'Connor: Also noticed some rows missing `gpu_type` so capacity calc falls back to 'unknown' which skews model. We should normalize to `instance_type` or `gpu.model` as a fallback.

Maria Chen: sample raw log we saw: `{"ts":1849123450,"source":"private","topology":{"zone_name":"a","region":"eu-west-1"},"gpu":{"seconds":3600}}`

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: alert: 120k raw_events with missing `zone` field ingested at 2026-03-18T14:02Z

AJ Patel: Plan: 1) quick parser patch to check `zone_name` & `gpu.model` fallbacks; 2) run reingest for last 48h for private orgs; 3) make dashboards tolerant of nulls. I can own parser + rollout.

Lee Nguyen: I'll draft the parser patch. Important: reingest must be idempotent. Use event_id dedupe (we already have it) and mark replayed=true to avoid double-counting.

Sophia Ramos: For backfill: start with 48h window, validate metrics, then expand to 7d if clean. I'll orchestrate the replay job and smoke-check the aggregated metrics. Also add unit tests for aggregated query.

Zach O'Connor: Cost/ops impact: if forecasts keep undercounting GPU hours, autoscaling might underprovision capacity. Quick estimate: 12-18 GPU-days/week shortfall if this continues for a week in EU alone. We should alert capacity owners.

Maria Chen: Assigning work: AJ + Lee = parser patch and canary deploy; Sophia = replay orchestration & validation; Zach = dashboard & capacity model updates. Tagging infra lead for capacity alerting: @ingrid?

Maria Chen: I'll create a Jira and link this thread.

AJ Patel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infer-ingest/pull/452 — adds canonicalization and unit tests. Caningary deploy in 5m.

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: replay job 2026-03-18-01 queued for 48h window (owner: Sophia).

Sophia Ramos: Started replay job 2026-03-18T14:20Z. ETA ~1.5h. Monitoring p99 ingest latency and duplication counters.

Lee Nguyen: Deployed parser patch to canary. No schema errors in logs so far (watching).

Maria Chen: Thanks all — will re-run the forecast job after replay completes and post updated projection.

AJ Patel: quick note: added a metric `ingest.zone-mapping-errors` to telemetry so we can alert if >1k/day.

Sophia Ramos: replay finished successfully, initial validation looks good (zone nulls dropped to <100 rows). I'll follow up with the 7d backfill if no regressions.

Maria Chen: great work — keeping an eye on capacity dashboard, will notify infra if we need short-term burst capacity. :thumbsup:
